name: Aaron K. Drake
office: City of Bellflower, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Aaron K. Drake is a detective and investigator who has been appointed to several city commissioner boards in Bellflower.

sentences.text: Aaron K. Drake is a detective and investigator who has been appointed to several city commissioner boards in Bellflower.

items.text: According to a voter guide from DSA Long Beach, he has advocated for capping rent increases beyond state requirements and using federal funds to help first-time home buyers. He names public safety, with a focus on reducing and preventing crime, as his top priority. He supports a comprehensive review of the policing budget.
